overview_description.description: Output Inc. is a technology company built by musicians. Our SaaS-based music creation platform Arcade allows the world’s top artists to break through writer’s block, and the rest of the world to break into music making. We’ve become the secret sauce behind so much music you’ve heard, including: Kendrick Lamar, Rihanna, Justin Timberlake, Stranger Things, Black Panther and Game Of Thrones. Please visit us at www.output.com or follow us on Instagram @output
